articles.title: 23 October 2028: Forget iPhone Duo, Ashwini Vaishnaw says India will have its own Apple and Samsung moment soon
articles.summary: The premium iPhone Duo rapidly sold out in India despite its hefty Rs 3 lakh price, highlighting a significant domestic demand for high-end smartphones. Capitalizing on this trend, India aims to develop and launch its own 'homegrown' premium smartphone alternatives within the next two years, fostering indigenous competition in this lucrative market segment.

articles.title: Evicting Ayodhya shopkeepers without rehabilitation ‘highly condemnable’: HC
